patch_description: The best-known configurations for 14 points (icosahedron + antipodal poles) are centrally symmetric. After the SLSQP polishing loop, we add a final refinement pass: (1) attempt antipodal symmetrization — pair each point with its best-matching antipodal partner (via a greedy matching on -P), average each point with the negation of its partner to enforce exact central symmetry, (2) run a short, tight SLSQP polish (maxiter 200, ftol 1e-16) from the symmetrized configuration. Since the optimum is believed to be centrally symmetric, projecting onto the symmetric subspace and re-polishing can jump past local minima of the generic optimization and land on the (better) symmetric optimum. We keep the better of the original and symmetrized-polished results, so this can only improve the outcome.
